items.title: Mcbee interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2020
items.q: Richard Davis, who is to this day my previous idol... found my initial techniques for teaching the placement of the quarter note was through that record “Karma.”

ctx.x: Can you describe, first, a recording session with Pharoah Sanders. What did you know beforehand, if anything, when you went to the session? Had you played the music live?

Yeah. Yeah. We, yeah occasionally the music was played live previously, which would upgrade or prepare you for the recording. You know sometimes when you enter the studio you’re unfamiliar with you know any kind of performance of that particular selection. You might have to really focus on the responsibilities that I just explained. But Pharoah was one who — I met Pharoah when I was playing a couple of gigs with Alice Coltrane. And it was like somehow, I forget, but somehow I — oh yeah, I had heard Pharoah’s…
